invariants.name: Zero-Secret Leakage Pre-Publish Barrier
invariants.description: Deterministic regex and entropy verification against active API tokens (OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, Anthropic, GitHub, AWS, private keys) before any commit or public release.

invariants.name: Cryptographic Merkle Root Integrity
invariants.description: Every active canonical skill must match its SHA-256 content digest and resolve to the immutable Merkle Root urn:skill-registry:merkle-tree:v1.

invariants.name: Fail-Closed Quarantine Barrier & Custody Ledger
invariants.description: Unverified or suspect skills and candidate tools are held in governance/quarantine-link.json. Testing tools (e.g. payloadsallthethings) require explicit cryptographic waiver WAIVER-2026-SEC-010.

invariants.name: Token Budget Compounding Defense
invariants.description: SKILL.md frontmatters must be strictly concise (<= 15 words) with zero embedded shell scripts or bloat, keeping customization token consumption under 25% of total budget.

invariants.name: Local-First Sovereign Isolation
invariants.description: Vault notes, vector memories, and local execution logs never leave the sovereign host without explicit, user-initiated cryptographic routing.

invariants.name: System Path Anonymization & Redaction
invariants.description: All public-facing documentation, manifests, and logs redact host-specific user directories (e.g. C:\Users\Ad\) to canonical environment placeholders ($REGISTRY_ROOT).

invariants.name: Role-Based Agent Isolation & Mutation Consent
invariants.description: Autonomous Quantum Agents operate in read-only forensic mode by default; any mutating or filesystem write requires explicit user approval flag (-Approved).

invariants.name: Multi-Platform Dependency Pinning
invariants.description: Cross-platform adapters (Gemini, Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, Cursor, Generic) must have exact lockfiles and pinned manifest references across all 870 platform pins.

invariants.name: Universal Accessibility & Cognitive Ergonomics
invariants.description: All interfaces and HUD components must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards: high contrast (>4.5:1), semantic ARIA landmarks, focus rings (:focus-visible), and complete keyboard navigability.

invariants.name: Deterministic Pre-Publish Audit Gate
invariants.description: Public release packaging requires an automated exit code 0 from the sovereign security auditor, validating absence of browser profile caches, temporary dumps, and unmasked keys.

invariants.name: Responsible Vulnerability Disclosure Framework
invariants.description: Standardized private reporting workflow via SECURITY.md, preventing public zero-day exposure in issue trackers.

invariants.name: Immutable Quantum Ledger
invariants.description: Every agent execution, audit result, and mission evidence record is appended to state/quantum-agent-ledger.jsonl with millisecond timestamps and deterministic outputs.

invariants.name: Fail-Safe Rollback & Recovery Checkpoints
invariants.description: Atomic snapshots and rollback transactions enable instant reversion to recovery-checkpoint.json upon any security gate breach or platform anomaly.

invariants.name: Zero-Trust Network Microsegmentation & Docker Boundary
invariants.description: Subnets alone do not constitute security boundaries. Enforces default-deny ACLs, guest client isolation, private management plane (ZTNA/Bastion), loopback binding to eliminate Docker iptables/UFW bypass, and quadruple release gate verification.
